Measured by the scene_eyes DEX-GRASP detector. Answers whether PhysX friction + the 3-finger hand can cage+hold a cube at all (open-loop; production = learned policy).
thoughts: Open-loop friction grasp (websearch: production G1 dex grasp = GR00T policy / teleop-retarget, not open-loop drives -> expect fragility). # CP-G1-GRASP-01: HONEST friction dex-grasp tractability probe (standing G1, root-weld, NO FixedJoint grip).
# Reach the left arm toward a cube + close the 3 fingers (thumb opposes index/middle) to friction-cage it.
# Measured by the scene_eyes DEX-GRASP detector. Open-loop (production path = learned policy); this answers
# whether PhysX friction + the 3-finger hand can hold a 5cm cube at all.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": True, "gravity_magnitude": 9.81, "gravity_direction": [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]})

create_prim(prim_path="/World/G1", prim_type="Xform", position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.793])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/G1", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Samples/Groot/Robots/g1_29dof_with_hand_rev_1_0.usd")
run_usd_script(code="import omni.usd\nfrom pxr import UsdPhysics, UsdGeom, Usd, Sdf, Gf\nstage = omni.usd.get_context().get_stage()\npelvis = stage.GetPrimAtPath('/World/G1/pelvis')\nif pelvis.IsValid():\n    m = UsdGeom.Xformable(pelvis).ComputeLocalToWorldTransform(Usd.TimeCode.Default())\n    pos = m.ExtractTranslation(); rot = m.ExtractRotationQuat()\n    fj = UsdPhysics.FixedJoint.Define(stage, '/World/G1_RootWeld')\n    fj.GetBody1Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path('/World/G1/pelvis')])\n    fj.CreateLocalPos0Attr(Gf.Vec3f(float(pos[0]), float(pos[1]), float(pos[2])))\n    fj.CreateLocalRot0Attr(Gf.Quatf(float(rot.GetReal()), Gf.Vec3f(*[float(x) for x in rot.GetImaginary()])))\n    fj.CreateLocalPos1Attr(Gf.Vec3f(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)); fj.CreateLocalRot1Attr(Gf.Quatf(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0))\n    print('GRASP: root-weld done')\n", description="Root-weld the G1 so it stands under gravity")

# Pedestal + a SMALL graspable cube (4cm, easier to cage than 5cm) at the left-hand reach.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.30, 0.18, 0.405], scale=[0.05, 0.05, 0.40])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.30, 0.18, 0.85], size=0.04)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")

# REACH the left arm toward the cube (palm to the cube region, proven in CP-G1-STAND-01).
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/G1/torso_link/left_shoulder_pitch_joint", attr_name="drive:angular:physics:targetPosition", value=48.0)

verified_status: MEASURED-BOUNDARY (cont.319jj, RAW via scene_eyes DEX-GRASP detector): open-loop friction dex-grasp does NOT work -> NOT dex-gripped. Two findings: (1) the asset's finger drives ship at stiffness=1e7, DAMPING=0, mass~0.02kg = an undamped omega~22000 rad/s oscillator that EXPLODES the articulation at 60Hz (finger joints hit 1e12 deg). FIX (reusable for ANY G1 finger work): set finger drive stiffness~1e4 + damping~300 -> fingers close SMOOTHLY to target (index_1=-95, thumb_2=85 deg, no explosion). (2) Even with stable fingers, the open-loop arm reach+close KNOCKS the cube away (start [0.31,0.23,0.82] -> end [1.0,-0.38,0.52], off the pedestal) before a stable opposing-finger cage forms -> the friction grip never captures it. This matches the literature (websearch): production G1 dex grasp = LEARNED POLICY (GR00T N1) / teleop-retargeting, NOT open-loop drives. The honest grasp is policy-scale, out of scope for open-loop Kit iteration. NO FixedJoint used (Anton's rule). The scene_eyes DEX-GRASP detector correctly read the no-cage/knock as NOT-dex-gripped (friction-enforcing).
